steps: Gently bash the cucumbers with a rolling pin until they break up into large pieces. Chop these up into bite-sized pieces then trim and thinly slice the spring onions.
Chop up the halloumi into 2cm chunks and pan-fry them with a glug of olive oil until golden brown and crispy, 3-5 mins.

In a large bowl, add in your tahini, soy sauce, rice vinegar and crispy chilli oil. Stir together and add 1 tbsp of cold water at a time until the dressing is smooth. Taste and season with salt, if needed.
Add the cucumbers, halloumi and spring onions to the dressing. Toss well and serve up in bowls with some more chilli oil, enjoy!
